description: Hawai'i Climate Adaptation Portal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Hawai‘i Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation Commission; Hawai'i Department of Land and Natural Resources; State of Hawai'i | Office of Planning. Despite global efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, the state of Hawai'i recognizes that climate change impacts will require adaptation to new conditions. This portal provides information to help residents understand climate science and take steps to prepare for climate change. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Landslides, Erosion and Shoreline Recession. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
